description: This file defines an interface class IActiveRequests for managing active media requests within the Rialto server component. It declares methods for inserting, retrieving, erasing, and managing media request segments, serving as a contract for implementing classes.

classes.name: IActiveRequests
classes.description: An interface class for managing active media requests, including methods for inserting requests, retrieving their types, erasing requests, adding segments, and retrieving segments.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new media request with specified media source type and maximum media bytes.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Retrieves the media source type associated with a given request ID.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes a request by its request ID.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes a request by its media source type.

methods.name: addSegment
methods.description: Adds a media segment to a request identified by request ID.

methods.name: getSegments
methods.description: Retrieves all media segments associated with a request ID.
